all_recorded_controller_resources.ssh_only_child_peak_reason: The sampler records descendant PIDs without executable classification.

limitations: This is a bounded six-host read-only observation experiment, not launch throughput or HTTP capacity.
A native accepted snapshot and later tail start do not observe pool permit acquisition directly.
Only 32 cold calls per version in a complete run; no confidence interval or universal fairness guarantee.
Response byte sizes are not retained-buffer occupancy measurements.
Unknown/failed/incomplete/gate-invalid evidence is preserved and cannot establish a fairness benefit.

method.aggregation: Every retained wave and row is included. Count/sum(full cell seconds), never a mean of rates; cell time and CPU include metadata gates/final queries.
method.comparison: Requires A20/A21 ABBA, two rounds per version, sixteen waves/160 calls per cell/version, 32 verified cold read rows/version, complete gate/history receipts, immutable inputs and locally verified measured helper hashes.
method.failures: A complete comparison may retain RPC failures; both versions' verdicts and all failure counts remain explicit. No adoption recommendation is inferred.
method.gate: Recheck native accepted count/IDs/tool-count receipt, unfinished heads and post-hoc call timing. Native dispatch admission does not prove pool permits, SSH dispatch or remote execution admission.
method.latency: Nearest-rank p50/p95/p99 over all calls in the relevant role, including refusals/timeouts. Missing/invalid latency makes the full quantile unavailable; no successful-only subset.
method.refusals: Counts native isError or RPC/error responses; this is not a claim that every error occurred at pool admission. Original error details and hashes remain in the report.
method.resources: 100ms controller/process-tree lifetime samples, including warmup/shutdown. Lower bounds with every recorded sampling error; descendants are not classified as SSH-only.
method.role_rates: Head and tail rates share the full elapsed cell denominator. CPU is attributed only to the whole cell, not allocated to a role.
method.smoke: Same-binary and abbreviated smoke data are pipeline checks. No performance comparison is emitted in smoke mode.

method.admission_boundary: Native dispatch admission is observed; pool eligibility, global permit ownership and remote execution admission are not directly observed.
method.admission_gate: Eight distinct new request_history records must be accepted and eight head futures unfinished before tail submission; no head may finish before first tail call starts.
method.balanced: Deterministic cyclic distribution over six hosts; status/read alternate in blocks of six. Exact per-host/tool counts are recoverable from all rows.
method.counterbalance: ABBA; cell order balanced/hot_only/skew then reverse alternates so both versions see both orders.
method.hot_only: All ten calls are mac process_status; detects hot-host acceptance and throughput regressions.
method.resource_scope: Existing 100ms local controller/tree sampler; sampled lower bounds, descendant executables unclassified.
method.retention: Process status/read have metadata-only native result retention; record complete response hashes and canonical serialized response sizes, not an unobserved retained-buffer peak.
method.shape: All cells use eight head calls, the same live metadata gate, then two tail calls; tail is still attempted if the gate fails.
method.skew: Eight mac process_status calls followed by two ai395 process_read calls.
method.timing: Cell wall time and CPU include metadata gates and final metadata observations; row latency is the individual original-job RPC including validation.

report.transport: native stdio MCP, one concurrent session per controller
